spec: ADAPTERS.md, Agents driven through ACP; CONTROL.md §2 (`mode`)
note: What an ACP agent's process is given for the machine's mode, where the agent's own default would act on what the mode says must ask. `env` is added to the process's environment for that run only and never saved anywhere; `{}` is nothing added, so the agent starts in its own default. `safe` is "anything that would ask is denied", `auto` is "the harness's auto mode", `inherit` is "no permission flag". An agent with no case here gets nothing for any mode. Measured against fx 0.0.16 on 2026-11-16: with nothing added, fx's `auto` wrote a file and ran a shell command for a safe machine without asking; with `ask`, the write reached `session/request_permission` and was refused.

cases.name: fx on a safe machine asks for every call that needs approval, so the daemon's refusal is the answer
fx on an auto machine runs in fx's own auto mode
fx on an inherit machine starts in the person's own fx setting
an agent with no word for the mode gets nothing added
